description: Texas legal fee check — one fee. One Texas judgment-work fee from the Ni Biashara Legal Shelf: the amount, the publishing office's source, and its confirmation status — confirmed on the office's own schedule, reported, a documented example county, or unconfirmed. An unconfirmed fee is answered with what is known, never an invented number. General information about public court processes, not legal advice. $0.05 USDC on Base. Returns the x402 URL to GET (402 → PAYMENT-SIGNATURE → delivery). Free to call this tool; payment happens on the URL.
